mapper.sql: id, user_id, species_id, name, pot_material, init_height_cm, emotion_tag, status, last_water_at, water_interval_days, photo_url, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plant_profile WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plant_profile(user_id, species_id, name, pot_material, init_height_cm, emotion_tag, status, last_water_at, water_interval_days, photo_url, created_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{speciesId}, #{name}, #{potMaterial}, #{initHeightCm}, #{emotionTag}, #{status}, #{lastWaterAt}, #{waterIntervalDays}, #{photoUrl}, #{createdAt})
